directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Arnie, I'm here on business. What can you tell me about that spooky note?
entries.JA_current: Arnie, I'm here on business. What can you tell me about that spooky note?
entries.JA_new: アーニー、仕事で来た。あの不気味な手紙について、何か知らないか？

entries.EN: The one from three days ago? Yeah, it wasn't just me that got it, Barkeep and Voronin also got one each.
entries.JA_current: The one from three days ago? Yeah, it wasn't just me that got it, Barkeep and Voronin also got one each.
entries.JA_new: 3日前のやつか？ああ、俺だけじゃない。バーキープとヴォロニンにも一通ずつ届いてた。

entries.EN: Who do you think it could be?
entries.JA_current: Who do you think it could be?

entries.EN: If I'd known, I wouldn't have sat around with idle hands. Sure, I've made some enemies, but this lunatic wants to blow up the whole Bar to hell! Personally, I think this is the work of the monolith group, those psychos from up North who defend the center!
entries.JA_current: If I'd known, I wouldn't have sat around with idle hands. Sure, I've made some enemies, but this lunatic wants to blow up the whole Bar to hell! Personally, I think this is the work of the monolith group, those psychos from up North who defend the center!
entries.JA_new: 知ってたら、ぼんやり座ってなんかいないさ。恨みを買った覚えはあるけど、こいつはロストクごと吹き飛ばす気だ！俺はモノリスの仕業だと思う。北で中心部を守ってる、あのイカれた連中さ！

entries.EN: Why do you think the terrorist sent notes to you, the bartender, and the general?
entries.JA_current: Why do you think the terrorist sent notes to you, the bartender, and the general?
entries.JA_new: テロリストがあんたとバーキープ、それに将軍へ手紙を送ったのはなぜだと思う？

entries.EN: Well, because we are the most influential people here, we hold the most authority! Why?
entries.JA_current: Well, because we are the most influential people here, we hold the most authority! Why?
entries.JA_new: ここで一番顔が利くし、権限もあるからさ！それがどうした？

entries.EN: Did you have any common business affairs with the other two?
entries.JA_current: Did you have any common business affairs with the other two?
entries.JA_new: ほかの二人と、何か共同で商売でもしてたのか？

entries.EN: I don't understand, are you looking for this terrorist or are you trying to stick your nose into my business?
entries.JA_current: I don't understand, are you looking for this terrorist or are you trying to stick your nose into my business?
entries.JA_new: 何が聞きたいんだ？テロリストを探してるのか、それとも俺の商売に首を突っ込みたいだけか？

entries.EN: I'm gathering information so that the worst can be prevented.
entries.JA_current: I'm gathering information so that the worst can be prevented.
entries.JA_new: 最悪の事態を防ぐために情報を集めてる。
